Customer-convenience and reliability pass from a three-part audit (UX flows, system robustness, scoring correctness) Scoring: last-hole save now shows the round-end sheet (it was closed by the score sheet), ▶ on the last hole ends the round instead of wrapping to hole 1, '공 찾았어요' and lost-ball '찾았어요' can't record twice, cancel in both screens removes the stroke and an auto-learned tee, friends' scores are entered in the same score sheet, putts added on an unsaved hole count toward the total, '모두 기준타' no longer finalises partial holes, a chip within 25 m of the flag can still be recorded, an old lost-ball search can't add a penalty to a new round Auto hole/green: no hole switch while a shot is live or the score sheet is open, only the next hole's tee counts, 3-minute pause after a manual hole change unless the hole is saved; greens are not learned when scoring a hole after reaching the next one; voice and toasts use scorecard hole numbers Data safety: save failures return false and raise a backup/cleanup sheet, round end saves rounds before clearing the live round, corrupt stored values kept aside, full backup/restore (merge rounds and shots) with native file sharing (@capacitor/filesystem, @capacitor/share), storage meter and cache cleanup, green height grids stored as 16-bit 0.1 mm base64 (one 9-hole course 2.6 MB → 0.4 MB) Comfort: Android back closes sheets/drawer, goes back to play, double press to exit (@capacitor/app); location denied/weak signal explained with fix steps, map-tap fallback and retry; GPS and screen-on resume when returning to the app; error log and retry card; plain words in remaining lost-ball and green messages System: APK reads pre-downloaded map tiles from Cache Storage (tiles now stored CORS-readable), bundled course lists for first run on weak signal, pins saved only when changed, service worker falls back to the cached copy after 3 s and only serves index.html for navigations, small escaping fixes

Settings and score sheet in plain words: settings ask easy questions (쉬운/자세히 화면, 보통 몇 타 치나요?, 치는 손, 내 키 → eye and chest height computed, 퍼팅 실력 잘해요/보통/연습 중 → aim and speed spread, 그린 빠르기 느려요/보통/빨라요, 경기 방식 대회/친구랑/연습); expert numbers (camera field of view, σ, raw handicap, Stimp, step length) and fake-GPS testing folded into '전문가 숫자'; AI caddie folded Score sheet: 기준 4타 (파 4), labelled 친 횟수 / 그린에서 steppers, 모두 기준타(파)로, plain legend and totals (기준보다 ±0, 그린에서 친 횟수, 잃어버린 공), 내기 계산 / 누가 누구에게, 오늘 라운드 끝내기; mode names 대회 · 친구랑 · 연습 everywhere; top bar '1번 홀 · 파 4 · 치는 중'

Green reading in plain words (easy screen): tabs ① 재기 · ② 그린 지도 · ③ 카메라로 보기; green speed as 느려요/보통/빨라요 (Stimp number folded away, μ hidden); slope readings as '오르막이에요 · 오른쪽이 높아요 → 공이 왼쪽으로 휘어요'; result as '어디를 보고: 홀 왼쪽으로 27cm (컵 2.5개)' and '얼마나 세게: 퍼터를 뒤로 30cm 빼서 쳐요' with a bar, plus '한 번에 들어갈 / 두 번 안에 넣을 확률'; speech, map legend, AR hints and buttons rewritten; Monte Carlo table, initial speed and error assumptions stay in the detail screen

Lost-ball flow joined to play and in plain words: '공이 안 보여요' hands over the shot position, club and direction (pointed or aimed) so '바로 찾으러 가기' works in one tap; '찾았어요' returns to play which measures the distance and shows the result card (one record, search learning kept); '못 찾았어요' explains the two options in plain words, adds the penalty, ends the live shot and returns to play; a newer hand-off replaces an old unfinished search All lost-ball labels rewritten without jargon (공을 친 곳, 얼마나 잘 맞았나요?, 친구가 본 곳, 여기는 없어요, 찾을 범위 반지름…); expert numbers only in the detail screen

Precise live direction arrows: the pointing heading comes from the full rotation matrix (top edge of the phone, switching to the camera axis when held upright, so sideways roll or tilt no longer skews it), smoothed with a One-Euro filter and drawn with shortest-path animation stepped on every sensor reading Lost-ball direction step: north-up compass dial whose needle follows the phone, flag marker, '137.4° 남동 · 깃발에서 오른쪽 23°' text, live lime line on the map, hand-shake warning (residual from the smoothed direction, silent while turning) and 1 s capture that rejects shaky readings and reports ± spread Search guide arrow and the walk-to-ball arrow now turn smoothly as the phone turns

Even easier: tapping a course starts hole 1 right away (course order and players default, change them under 더보기 → 코스·친구 바꾸기); one-line location prompt; easy-mode map shows only me, landing dot and flag line (no rings, hazard numbers, angle labels or glass chips); club advice as one sentence with a direction arrow, wind mentioned only when strong Real courses without green data: the first shot position is learned as the tee, the spot where the hole score is saved (far enough from the tee) is learned as the green, an estimated distance (hole length minus distance from tee) is shown meanwhile, and shots can be recorded and measured without a green Plain words on the shot result card (잰 값 / 추정 / 기계, 공중으로 간 거리, 굴러간 거리, 뜬 각도, 공 회전…), 4 numbers shown and the rest folded

Design v2 (premium golf app language): sage background, lime accent, black pill buttons with a lime arrow circle, big bold question titles over a contour-line pattern, satellite-photo course thumbnails and a full-photo 'play here' card, glass hole bar and glass map chips (wind relative to the shot, flag elevation, distance left after the shot), lime main button, floating pill tab bar, dark stats card with left/centre/right result bar, restyled score sheet, result card and map labels; night-green header and status bar; dark mode checked Nearby-course card now also appears when the GPS fix arrives after the list loads

Launch monitor CSV import: finds the header row (skipping info lines), unit row ([mph], [yds]) and units in column names, auto-maps common column names from Garmin R10, Rapsodo MLM2PRO, FlightScope, TrackMan and Korean devices, reads quoted CSV with comma/semicolon/tab, decimal commas, '5.2 L' style sides and EUC-KR files; preview lets the user fix column mapping, default units, club-name mapping and left/right sign before importing; putters dropped, re-imported shots skipped by key Direction for monitor shots now prefers offline distance (where the ball went) over launch direction

Launch monitor input: enter ball speed (required), launch angle, spin, club speed, carry, total, side angle/offline and apex from a launch monitor on the shot result card or any saved shot, or add a monitor-only shot (range / simulator, no GPS); km/h·mph·m/s and m·yd units remembered, range checks catch unit mix-ups, values tagged 모니터/GPS/계산 per field, empty fields computed by the flight model, GPS distance kept when present, model-vs-monitor carry difference and smash factor shown; per-club stats prefer monitor ball speed, launch and spin

Shot analysis: right after '쳤어요' the predicted ball speed, launch angle, apex and flight time; on '찾았어요' a result card with measured distance (GPS, ± error) and direction, and ball speed, head speed, carry, roll, apex, flight time, landing angle/speed computed by solving the 3-DOF flight model backwards from the measured distance with wind and air density (launch ±3°, spin ±15% ranges), plus a side-view flight curve; every shot saved with its analysis '📈 내 샷 기록': per-club average/longest distance, ball speed, apex, direction mean and spread, top-view landing scatter, per-shot cards and delete; partial-power shots stay out of averages and club distance learning
